title: Google AI Mode Now Has Its Own Incognito Mode 🕵️
description:
Google AI Mode now has temporary threads, an incognito-style chat inside AI search. Tap the pen icon with the dotted border in the top-right corner of AI Mode: the chat is not saved to your history, your past preferences don't shape the answers, and once you close it, it's gone. It is rolling out worldwide on desktop and mobile browsers in every AI Mode language.

What would you search in secret? Tell us in the comments!

🔔 Follow AI Daily Drop for the newest AI tools and tech news every day.

Source: Google, "Temporary threads are now available in AI Mode in Search" (November 17, 2026); TechCrunch and 9to5Google (November 17-18, 2026)
